articles.title: Rally Countdown: Three Open Buses Ready at Kharge’s Residence for INDIA Alliance Leaders
articles.description: Preparations for the INDIA alliance rally are underway at both Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence and Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan. At Kharge’s residence, three open buses have been arranged to transport INDIA alliance floor leaders towards the rally venue. According to the report, the leaders will travel first to Minto Bridge before proceeding towards Ramlila Maidan. The buses carry the slogans “Delhi Chalo,” “Desh Bachao” and “Vote Bachao,” reflecting the Opposition’s campaign message. Meanwhile, ABP News correspondent Pawan Gaur reported from Ramlila Maidan that participants had started arriving gradually by around 9:30 AM. The front section of the venue, prepared for the gathering, was almost filled, while more workers were expected to arrive as the day progressed. The main rally programme is scheduled to begin at 12 noon. Preparations were also underway on the stage, with leaders and security personnel beginning to arrive. Senior leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, are expected to attend. The report highlights the final arrangements for the Opposition’s major political gathering in the national capital.

articles.title: No GPS, no permits: Tamil Nadu bars mineral transport vehicles without tracking devices from Nov 1
articles.description: No vehicles will be allowed to transport minerals without GPS devices installed by November 1. The devices must be integrated with the state's MiMAS portal for real-time location tracking. Currently, around 1.10 lakh vehicles are registered, but only 50,000 actively transport minerals. Lorry owners must purchase devices from approved vendors, with costs now around ₹4000. Failure to comply will result in legal action against lorry owners.

articles.title: Amit Shah Flags Off Run For Unity on Sardar Patel's 151st Birth Anniversary | National Unity Day|N18
articles.description: India marks the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the Iron Man of India, with celebrations of Rashtriya Ekta Diwas or National Unity Day. Union Home Minister Amit Shah flagged off the Run for Unity in New Delhi at the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, paying tribute to Patel's historic contribution to India's unity and national integration. Addressing the gathering, Shah recalled how Sardar Patel played a crucial role in bringing hundreds of princely states together after Independence, helping shape India's political and geographical map.
